blocks.h2: Why Sewer Lines Fail in Hinsdale
blocks.intro: About 1 in 6 Hinsdale homes was built before 1940, and more than 4 in 10 went up after 1990, often where an older house stood. Both ends of that range bring sewer trouble.

items.body: Houses around Robbins Park and the older blocks near downtown often still drain through clay pipe. Every joint is an opening for roots.
When a house is rebuilt, the line to the street isn't always replaced. A camera look tells you whether yours was.
Hinsdale's big elms, oaks and maples have had decades to find the sewer.
About a quarter of homes date from 1940 to 1969. Their lines are now 57 to 86 years old.

Spot repair, lining or replacement, based on what the video shows.
A flat rate you approve, with the footage to support it.

blocks.h2: How We Repair a Sewer Line
blocks.intro: Once we know what's wrong, there's usually more than one way to fix it. Which method makes sense depends on the pipe's condition, location, and how it failed.
head: Method
What It Involves
Typical Disruption
rows: A resin-coated liner is pulled through the existing pipe and cured in place, creating a new pipe inside the old one.
Minimal digging, usually just small access points
A new pipe is pulled through the old one while a bursting head fractures the old pipe outward to make room.
Minimal digging, works even when the old pipe is badly damaged
The damaged section is dug up and replaced directly.
More digging, but sometimes the only option depending on damage location and access
blocks.note: Hinsdale lots often have mature trees, stone walks and finished landscaping over the sewer path. The camera footage tells us which method keeps them intact.

blocks.h2: Sewer Repair Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: We built a new home. Why would the sewer line be old?
items.preview: The builder may have reused the existing lateral.
items.answer: If the builder tied into the existing lateral instead of running a new one, your new house is draining through the old pipe. A [camera inspection](/hinsdale/video-camera-sewer-inspections) shows what's there.

items.q: Can you repair a line without disturbing landscaping or a stone walk?
items.answer: Often. [Trenchless repair](/hinsdale/trenchless-sewer-repair) works through small openings, so most hardscape and plantings can stay in place.

items.q: Is it the sewer line or the village main?
items.preview: The camera shows where the problem is.
items.answer: We run the camera to the main and mark where the problem is. If it's in the village sewer, we'll tell you so you can report it.

items.q: Should we repair the line before finishing the basement?
items.answer: Yes. Camera the main and the drains under the floor before the new finishes go in. Fixing a break first costs far less than opening a finished floor later.

items.q: How much does sewer line repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: That depends on the damage and the method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what the camera finds, the depth and length of the damaged section, the repair method and what's on top of it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before work begins.
